style: Ralf Rangnick's aggressive Gegenpressing: high pressing, intense counter-pressing and tightly coordinated defensive structure. Austria suffocate opponents in midfield and look to win the ball high; since Euro 2024 they have allowed opponents the lowest pass-completion rate of any side in the World Cup field.
recent_form: Well-drilled and confident under Rangnick after a strong qualifying campaign. The pressing system is mature and the squad arrives with a clear, organised identity; opened the tournament against Jordan.

key_players.name: David Alaba
key_players.note: Real Madrid veteran and four-time Champions League winner; organises the back line and brings elite experience.

key_players.name: Marcel Sabitzer
key_players.note: Borussia Dortmund engine providing creativity, drive and goals from midfield.

key_players.name: Konrad Laimer
key_players.note: Bayern Munich starter ideal for Rangnick's high-energy press and ball-winning.

key_players.name: Marko Arnautovic
key_players.note: 37-year-old record goalscorer and most-capped player; experienced focal point up front.

key_players.name: Xaver Schlager
key_players.note: RB Leipzig midfielder who covers ground and sustains the pressing intensity.

key_players.name: Kevin Danso
key_players.note: Tottenham centre-back providing physicality and aerial strength alongside Alaba.

historical_news: Ralf Rangnick has transformed Austria into one of Europe's best-organised pressing teams.
Captain David Alaba leads the squad after returning from injury; Marko Arnautovic serves as vice-captain.
Austria reached the Euro 2024 round of 16 after topping a group containing France and the Netherlands.
Possesses the strongest pressing defensive metrics of any World Cup team since Euro 2024.
Marko Arnautovic continues as the nation's all-time leading scorer and most-capped player.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Regarded as a well-coached dark horse capable of upsetting bigger names thanks to Rangnick's pressing system, though questions remain over goalscoring depth.
